headers: Project Admin Module Workflow Role Name

rows.Description: The host organization that owns BIM 360 projects.
A document or image attached for reference to an issue.

Organize projects to correspond to different business units within an organization. For example, a construction firm may have different divisions for different project types (buildings, interiors, infrastructure). The information can then be used for reporting and analytics.
A list of points or questions that need to be verified in order to assess the safety or quality of work completed by a trade in a given location or the correct installation of a piece of equipment.
Outlines the structure and content of a checklist.
An organization that contributes to a project. Every project member is associated with a company.

Each project is assigned a set of containers that stores all the issues and checklists for the project. This is relevant for the Issues API and the Checklist API. The container ID is used to call BIM 360 Issues and Checklists endpoints. You need to use the Data Management API (GET hubs/:hub_id/projects) to find the Container IDs.
An item that is created in BIM 360 for tracking, managing and communicating problems and other points of concern through to resolution.
The primary organizing construct within which people work and content is managed in BIM 360.
A visual marker that denotes the location of an issue or RFI in a document.
An RFI (request for information) is a formal question asked by one project member of another, such as clarification of design intent from the architect.
Members participating in your BIM 360 account.
